name: Yellow Moong Dal Khichdi (With Ghee)
whyItWorks: Unlike whole brown lentils or chickpeas, split yellow moong dal has the outer hulls completely removed and cooks into a velvety pudding with basmati rice and zero-lactose ghee.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pressure-cook or simmer equal parts white basmati rice and split yellow moong dal with water/broth, turmeric, salt, and a spoonful of clarified butter (ghee) until completely smooth.
